jobDescription: A specialist mortgage lender services 28,000 residential loans. The Mortgage Servicing Analyst processes payment-date changes and overpayments, prepares the arrears contact list for the collections team, reconciles the monthly direct-debit run and covers the rate-change processing rota, which includes a weekend session whenever the lender's standard variable rate moves. An interview panel assesses each applicant from the evidence summary and its own interviews. The servicing team has 14 analysts and two team leaders. Most work arrives through a shared queue with daily service-level targets, and a second analyst checks every redemption figure before release. The team works closely with collections, the complaints team and the finance team that reconciles the loan book each month. The role is office-based three days a week.
requirements: Processes payment-date changes, overpayments and redemption statements accurately.
Reconciles the monthly direct-debit collection run and investigates rejected collections.
Covers the rate-change processing rota, including weekend sessions when rates change.
Prepares the daily arrears contact list for the collections team.
Applies the lender's vulnerable-customer procedures when handling servicing requests.

evidence.text: Processed payment-date changes, overpayments and redemption statements on the Phoebus servicing platform at Kestrel Home Loans, with a four-eyes check on every redemption figure.
Reconciled the monthly direct-debit run of about 19,000 collections against the bank file and worked the rejected-collection (ARUDD) report with the collections team.

Worked the rate-change processing rota, including the weekend sessions after the base-rate changes of February, May and August 2023, recalculating payments and checking customer letters before release.
Built the daily arrears contact list from the servicing platform each morning, flagging accounts with a promise to pay falling due that day.
Completed the lender's annual vulnerable-customer training.

Work sample: the rate-change rota and sign-off sheet for the August 2023 weekend session, listing the candidate as one of four processors, the 2,140 accounts recalculated and the team leader's sign-off of the letter checks.
HR verification note: employment at Kestrel Home Loans from October 2020 to the present as Servicing Analyst, checked against the HR letter supplied by the employer.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate is available for interview on Wednesday afternoons and has asked whether the role is hybrid.
